content.stem: 金融行动特别工作组(FATF)的主要目标是:(选择两项.)

options.A: 评估并监督对金融行动特别工作组（FATF）标准的遵守情况，并提出改进建议。
options.B: 协助各国执行欧盟、联合国及区域制裁制度。
options.C: 制定并推广国际标准以防范洗钱和恐怖主义融资。
options.D: 对各国的立法和法律进行调查，以防止其被用于洗钱和恐怖主义融资。
options.E: 确保各国遵守其法律以维持金融稳定。

content.stem_en: The primary objectives of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) are to: (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Evaluate and monitor compliance with the FATF standards and provide recommendations for improvement.
options_en.B: Assist countries in implementing EU, UN, and regional sanctions regimes.
options_en.C: Develop and promote international standards to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing.
options_en.D: Conduct investigations into countries' legislation and laws to prevent them from being used for money laundering and terrorist financing.
options_en.E: Ensure that countries follow its laws to maintain financial stability.
